Escort Supply Line

Screen your own siege's supply convoy. Adds one escort pip; each pip cancels one enemy interdiction at the next strategic tick and deters defender sorties (escort-protected hexes inflict heavier sortie casualties on the defender). Played by the besieger or a supporter. Target the siege's supply-road hex or the besieged hex.

Cost: Violence 10 · Logistics 10 marks
